This smartphone UI screen displays a list of exercises under the "Library" section. Each exercise entry includes a thumbnail image, the name of the exercise, and the type of equipment or method used (e.g., Dumbbells, Machine, Bodyweight). The exercises listed are:

1. Alternate Front Arm Raises (Dumbbells)
2. Angled Leg Presses (Machine)
3. Apana Pose, Wind Release Pose (Bodyweight)
4. Back Extension Prone (Bodyweight)

At the bottom of the screen, there is a prompt to choose an email app, with two options available: "Android Beam" and "Email."
